data_collection.declaration: The app collects only the minimum data required to provide its declared functionality. No third-party advertising SDKs are bundled.

scopes.data_handling: Encrypted in transit for the app-to-API hop: the shipped default GM_API_BASE is https://gm-console.kanvas.dev/api. NOT encrypted at rest by anything this repository configures -- see docs/commercial/PRIVACY.md section 8, which strikes through the earlier AES-256 claim for that reason. Retained while the account is active.

scopes.type: In-app actions (audit events: pipeline start, retry, acknowledge)
scopes.data_handling: Retained for up to 365 days; encrypted at rest; self-hosted deployments may disable entirely.

Not collected. The app ships no crash-reporting SDK (no sentry, firebase or analytics dependency in apps/gm-console-app/pubspec.yaml, no telemetry code under lib/). The previous text here claimed a managed SOC2-Type-II sub-processor; no managed tier exists -- docs/commercial/PRESS_KIT.md records it as roadmap.

data_sharing._note: The previous rationale here restated the rows of docs/commercial/SUB_PROCESSORS.md as the answer to this question -- 'Cloudflare edge, AWS k8s control plane in ap-northeast-1, GitHub source hosting, Sentry error tracking opt-in only, Postmark transactional email'. Four of those five are not integrated anywhere in this repository: Sentry and Postmark appear in no dependency and no configuration, and Cloudflare and AWS are neither configured nor deployed. Naming them to Google Play as the sub-processor set was a declaration the tree does not support, and it contradicted the 'Crash logs' scope above, which says no crash-reporting SDK ships.
data_sharing.rationale: All data collected by the app stays within the gm-console deployment the operator runs: the Flutter client ships no advertising, analytics or crash-reporting SDK, so it has no telemetry channel of its own. The three third parties its surrounding code can reach -- Stripe, PagerDuty and Slack -- are billing, paging and notification paths in server-side services, none of which the mobile app calls, and none of which appears in deploy/k8s/. They are recorded in docs/commercial/SUB_PROCESSORS.md under 'Integrated in this repository' with their conditions.

data_handling._encrypted_in_transit_note: True for the app-to-API hop only: the shipped default GM_API_BASE is an https:// URL. This repository configures no TLS inside the deployment -- deploy/ has no Ingress, the Services are ClusterIP, and PRIVACY.md section 8 records that the in-cluster Redis link is unauthenticated and unencrypted (deploy/infra/ada-session-redis.yaml). Termination inside the cluster is the operator's choice and is outside this repository.
data_handling._encrypted_at_rest_note: No volume encryption, managed-key encryption or application-level envelope encryption is configured anywhere in this repository. The previous value of true was not supported by any manifest; PRIVACY.md section 8 strikes through the earlier AES-256 claim for this reason.
data_handling.deletion_method: By email to privacy@kanvas.dev. That address is UNCONFIRMED -- docs/commercial/COMPLIANCE_SELFCHECK.md records it as not published anywhere in the repository -- so this field currently names a channel nobody has verified. There is no self-service deletion endpoint. The earlier text here offered 'self-service in a future v0.4.0 build (path tracked in docs/upstream/)': the workspace is 0.1.0, so v0.4.0 is a version this codebase has not reached, and docs/upstream/ tracks no deletion item at all -- its 12-entry issue list (docs/upstream/05-issue-list.md) has none. Resolve the mailbox before submitting.
data_handling._retention_note: 365 days appears in this file for app_activity. The shipped Loki retention is 30 days (observability/loki/loki-config.yaml); 365 days exists only as an Enterprise plan entitlement in crates/ada-billing/src/plan.rs, and there is no paid tier to grant it. Align these three numbers before submitting.

data_retention.account_info: While the account is active + 30 days after deletion request.
data_retention.app_activity: 30 days rolling window in the shipped configuration (observability/loki/loki-config.yaml). 365 days is an Enterprise entitlement in crates/ada-billing/src/plan.rs, not the default.
data_retention.crash_logs: Not collected -- the app ships no crash-reporting SDK. The retention stated here is vestigial.
